description: This file defines interfaces and macros related to mapping and pressure sensor readings, specifically for MAP (Manifold Absolute Pressure) and barometric sensors in an engine control system.

methods.name: initMapDecoder
methods.description: Initializes the MAP decoder with shared logger and engine parameters.

methods.name: getRawMap
methods.description: Returns the raw MAP sensor value at the current moment.

methods.name: hasBaroSensor
methods.description: Checks if the barometric sensor is present.

methods.name: hasMapSensor
methods.description: Checks if the MAP sensor is present.

methods.name: getMap
methods.description: Returns the MAP value averaged within a measurement window.

methods.name: getMapByVoltage
methods.description: Calculates MAP value based on the sensor voltage reading.

methods.name: decodePressure
methods.description: Converts voltage and sensor configuration into a pressure value.

methods.name: validateMap
methods.description: Validates the MAP value within acceptable parameters.
